digest.component_or_area: environment variable registry generator and documentation
propositions: Environment-read helpers absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS are silently ignored during registry generation, causing env variables to be undocumented
Two operator-settable variables (REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE) are currently undocumented in docs/env-vars.md due to missing _gate_str_pref registration
The registry scanner must detect parameterized-shim helpers (functions whose os.environ key expressions reference their own parameters) and fail closed when such helpers are not registered
The fix restores symmetric fail-closed behavior across both os.environ attribute access and helper-based env reads, raising UnregisteredEnvReadHelper instead of silently skipping unregistered helpers
Registering the three missing helpers (_gate_str_pref, read_secret_env, _env_truthy) adds two keys to the registry and improves docs/env-vars.md from 162 to 164 documented variables
